name: Highest-APR priority
limitation: Dispute protection takes precedence; deferred-window and request branches are separate.

name: Deferred-program applicability
limitation: External contract facts are trusted; this checks the proposed program classification.

name: Deferred-window priority
limitation: Simultaneously eligible deferred balances form one unordered priority group; disputed capacity comes last.

name: Optional deferred-program request
limitation: Targets need not themselves be deferred. Only recorded, specific instructions are supported.

name: Optional secured-balance request
limitation: Security-interest facts are externally established.

name: Excess-payment scope
limitation: Minimum accounting is supplied, not inferred by subtracting the full minimum from each payment.

name: Minimum amount outside scope
limitation: Other applicable law is outside this adapter.

name: Optional minimum allocation method
limitation: A permission is preserved by absence of an additional restriction.

name: Permitted snapshot date
limitation: Snapshots must be authoritative complete account snapshots.

name: Consistent reference-day practice
limitation: Operational choice, not a complete interpretation of 'generally'.

name: Permitted practice adjustments
limitation: Cannot determine legal acceptability of 'from time to time'; authorization evidence does not resolve that legal standard.

name: Residual after historical snapshot
limitation: Generalization of the single later-purchase example; later lots use their payment-date APR.

name: Minimize disputed reduction
limitation: Dispute protection overrides request and program priority. Dispute merits are external.

name: Error-correction credit
limitation: Required charge attribution and checkpoint deadline come from external section 1026.13 requirements; this does not initiate a credit.

name: Correction notice dispatch
limitation: Notice content certification is trusted external evidence; no autonomous dispatch or deadline scheduler.

name: Equal-rate discretion
limitation: Uses the enumerated exceptions, not a claim to resolve every possible meaning of 'generally'.

name: Grouped or separate balances
limitation: Do not merge away facts needed by other checks.

name: Zero allocation APR for deferred interest
limitation: The contractual interest accrual rate is not changed.

name: Incorporated deferred-interest definition
limitation: Full equivalence with section 1026.16(h)(2) and its commentary is not implemented or claimed.

name: Grace-period exclusion
limitation: Checks a proposed classification; does not add an allocation-priority obligation.

name: Temporary-zero exclusion
limitation: External rate-change legality is not checked.

name: Correct counted cycles
limitation: At least two actual cycles through the expiration cycle must be supplied.

name: Early-expiration partial cycle
limitation: Expiration dates are inclusive contract payoff dates in this model.

name: Issuer may decline requests
limitation: No policy requires the issuer to elect the request branch.

name: Decline requests failing issuer requirements
limitation: This permission does not require a separate rejection policy or mandate issuer requirements.

name: No request uses default
limitation: Complete request capture is assumed.

name: Unfulfillable request and replacement
limitation: Operational definition of inability; other meanings of 'cannot comply' remain unresolved.

name: Affirmative specific contact
limitation: Interpretation of a conversation into instructions is external evidence processing.

name: Request to reallocate previous payment
limitation: Caller supplies the authoritative pre-payment balance snapshot for replacement; replacement is atomic.

name: Imposed acceptance is insufficient
limitation: Whether a condition was imposed is externally evidenced.
